brand.style: Flat digital illustration, sacred geometry underpinnings, Pahari miniature painting simplified to flat vector shapes
constraints: absolutely no text, numbers, words, Sanskrit or Latin letters anywhere in the image
flat fills with subtle tonal gradation only, no photorealistic lighting
geometric borders in thin gold lines
no faces shown directly — use silhouettes, profiles, or symbolic representations

article.focalStrategy: Extract core visual metaphor from article title and primaryKeyword. Avoid generic pillar symbols — each article should feel distinct.

deity.compositionOverride: central figure silhouette, symmetrical framing, aura of radiant light behind figure, geometric mandala backdrop
deity.focalStrategy: Map iconographic attributes directly: weapons, vehicle, posture, symbols. Use silhouette with key distinguishing features visible in profile.
deity.paletteExtension: Allow deity-specific accent colors from iconography data

concept.focalStrategy: Use curated visual metaphor from conceptVisualMetaphors lookup. Every concept gets a deliberate, hand-crafted visual mapping.

comparison.compositionOverride: split composition — two symbolic elements facing each other across a central axis, connected by a geometric bridge or threshold element
comparison.focalStrategy: Two contrasting but harmonious visual symbols, one per entity, mirrored across center. Shared geometric frame unifying both.
comparison.altTextTemplate: {entityA} and {entityB} — contrasting philosophies in sacred geometry

stotra.compositionOverride: sacred flame or offering motif, deity silhouette receiving devotion, flowing geometric patterns suggesting chant rhythm
stotra.focalStrategy: Deity iconography in devotional context — figure receiving offering, cosmic dance, or meditative pose. Suggest the act of praise.

practice.compositionOverride: human figure in practice pose, surrounded by subtle energy patterns or concentric sacred geometry circles
practice.focalStrategy: Activity-based: figure performing the practice. Japa shows mala beads, dhyana shows seated meditation, pranayama shows breath flows.

tradition.focalStrategy: Tone-driven atmosphere reflecting the tradition's core orientation. Devotional traditions show offering/flame; contemplative show stillness/space; yogic show practice/discipline.

karma.focalElement: interconnected golden scales suspended in space, with ripples emanating outward from each weight, cause flowing into effect

moksha.focalElement: a luminous figure dissolving upward into infinite concentric circles of light, chains falling away below

samsara.focalElement: an endless wheel of six segments turning in space, tiny figures cycling through each segment, the wheel floating in a vast void

maya.focalElement: layered translucent veils dissolving one behind another, each veil a different geometric pattern, a faint light source behind the last veil

brahman.focalElement: an infinite field of radiant golden light with no center and no edge, subtle geometric patterns emerging and dissolving within it

yoga.focalElement: two streams — one ascending, one descending — merging at a central point within a seated silhouette, forming a unified geometric pattern

jnana.focalElement: an eye opening within a geometric mandala, layers of illusion peeling away concentrically around the eye, revealing clear space at center

viveka.focalElement: a sharp geometric blade of light dividing a field into two halves — one clear and luminous, one shadowed and complex
